rules: Percentages must be numeric values from 0 through 100.
Gap points equal target_percent minus score_percent when both exist.
Do not convert missing evidence into zero; use not_run or partial.
Composite scores must be reproducible from recorded dimensions.
Benchmark history must be append-only or versioned.
External benchmark results and DreamCo benchmark results must remain distinguishable.
A benchmark score is evidence of the tested task distribution, not universal mastery.
